text: I'm trying to sign in but it says my email doesn't exist in the system
expected_response: This can happen if the account was registered with a different email. Let me search our records using your name or alternate email to locate your account.

text: I changed phones and lost access to my authenticator codes
expected_response: I can help you regain access. If you have your backup recovery codes, you can use those to sign in. Otherwise, we'll need to verify your identity manually to reset two-factor authentication.

text: Someone else seems to have taken over my account, what do I do?
expected_response: I'm immediately securing your account by locking it. I'll guide you through our identity verification process so we can restore your access and revoke any unauthorized sessions.

text: I upgraded mid-cycle but was charged for the full month again
expected_response: When upgrading mid-cycle, you should only be charged the prorated difference. I see the extra charge and I'll apply a credit to your next invoice to correct this.

text: My annual subscription renewed at a higher price than I expected
expected_response: I apologize for the surprise. It looks like a pricing update took effect at renewal. Let me review your original agreement and see if we can honor the previous rate.

text: Can you break down what the extra charges on my latest invoice are for?
expected_response: Of course. I'll pull up your latest invoice and walk you through each line item so you can see exactly what each charge covers.

text: Our entire team is unable to access the platform right now
expected_response: We're aware of a platform-wide access issue currently affecting some users. Our engineering team is working on an urgent fix and we'll provide updates via our status page.

text: The search functionality has been returning errors all day
expected_response: Thank you for reporting this. We've identified an issue with our search indexing service and a fix is being deployed now. I'll follow up once search is fully operational again.

text: Any chance of adding two-factor authentication via hardware keys?
expected_response: Hardware key support via WebAuthn/FIDO2 is on our security roadmap. I've logged your request to help prioritize this feature with the product team.

text: We'd benefit from a webhook system for event-driven workflows
expected_response: Webhooks are a great idea for automation workflows. This is currently in our development pipeline, and I've added your feedback. I'll make sure you're notified when it's available.

text: Please consider adding support for SSO with SAML
expected_response: SAML-based SSO is available on our Enterprise plan. If you're on a different plan, I can connect you with sales to discuss options, or I can log this as a feature request for broader availability.

text: What's your uptime SLA for the business tier?
expected_response: Our Business tier comes with a 99.9% uptime SLA. If we fall below that threshold in any calendar month, you're eligible for service credits as outlined in our SLA documentation.

text: Does the platform comply with SOC 2 Type II?
expected_response: Yes, we are SOC 2 Type II certified. I can share our latest audit report under NDA with your security team if needed.

text: What's the recommended way to migrate data from our old system?
expected_response: We offer a migration tool that supports CSV and JSON imports, as well as direct connectors for common platforms. I can walk you through the migration wizard or connect you with our onboarding specialist.

text: I'm configuring the SDK but keep getting authentication errors
expected_response: Authentication errors usually mean the API key isn't being passed correctly. Make sure you're using the secret key (not the publishable key) and that it's set as an environment variable or in your config file.

text: What happens to my data after I cancel my subscription?
expected_response: After cancellation, your data is retained in read-only mode for 30 days. During that period you can reactivate or export your data. After 30 days, all data is permanently deleted.

text: I want to pause my subscription for a few months, is that an option?
expected_response: We do offer subscription pausing for up to 3 months. Your data and settings are preserved while billing is suspended. Would you like me to pause your subscription starting from the next billing date?

text: Are you compliant with CCPA and can I request data portability?
expected_response: Yes, we are fully CCPA compliant. You can submit a data portability request through Settings > Privacy, and we'll provide a machine-readable export of all your personal data within 45 days.

text: I want to restrict processing of my personal data under GDPR Article 18
expected_response: I'll flag your account for restricted processing immediately as per your GDPR Article 18 rights. Your data will be stored but not actively processed until the restriction is lifted at your request.

text: Where are your servers located and is data encrypted at rest?
expected_response: Our infrastructure is hosted in AWS data centers in the US (Virginia) and EU (Frankfurt). All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3.
